camel_example: aliyun iot ReBindLicenseDevice --region cn-hangzhou --LicenseCode LINK_SPEECH_COMMON_LICENSE --IotInstanceId 'iot-e3000' --DeviceNameList.1 testdevice --ProductKey a2YwD23000
description_en: Rebinds a license to multiple devices of a specific product
description_zh: 调用该接口为指定产品下设备重新授权License
kebab_example: aliyun iot re-bind-license-device --iot-instance-id iot-e3000 --license-code LINK_SPEECH_COMMON_LICENSE --product-key a2YwD23000 --device-name-list testdevice --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ReBindLicenseDevice

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

>  You must specify the ID of a public instance of the new version or an Enterprise Edition instance. Otherwise, the request fails. You do not need to specify the ID of a public instance of the previous version.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~) of IoT instances.
parameters.description_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 对于新版公共实例或企业版实例，实例有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 对于旧版公共实例，实例无ID值，无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。

The **ProductKey** of the product to which the devices belong.

The **DeviceNames** of all devices to which you want to rebind a license.

You can call the [QueryDevice](~~69905~~) operation to query the **DeviceNames** of all devices that belong to a specific product.
